paragraphs.text: Henzie "Toolbox" Torre is a Devil thief and the proprietor of Herculaneum Candy Shop in Upper Bridge Plaza, Park Heights of New Capenna . He is a member of the Riveteers .

Short and with a noticeably broken nose, Henzie wears slicked-back, pomaded hair to match his horns and a jeweler's glass in place of his right eye. He wears many golden rings and a cap around his horns.

If you're looking to hire "Toolbox," you better be ready to pay. That sly little acrobat can nab anything, but he'll want a cut off the top. And those services don't come cheap. His fiancée asked him to snag her a designer wedding gown, and he took her engagement ring back as payment. They didn't last too long after that.

He says he's part of the Riveteers and moves construction materials for them, but rumor has it that he's tucked away his private stash, hidden so good his boss, Ziatora , doesn't even know. That may be where all of those missing weapons shipments have ended up. He loves shiny things, always decked out in gems.
During the New Phyrexian Invasion , Henzie and the Riveteers sided with the returned angels and joined the resistance.
